verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official CLI (docs.sentry.io/cli) and explicitly positions it as part of AI-native workflows, e.g. 'Use Sentry without leaving your agent conversations by setting up the Sentry MCP server and Sentry CLI' and a one-command setup that teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok to configure Sentry. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the CLI specifically serves agentic/AI use cases beyond source-map/release management, and more detail on CLI commands tailored for AI agents rather than just infra tasks.
